changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE submission_revision ( submission_id varchar(26) NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL, previous_version bigint, kind varchar(16) NOT NULL, command varchar(32) NOT NULL, actor_user_id varchar(26), actor_system varchar(32), on_behalf_of_user_id varchar(26), reason text, recorded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), form_data jsonb, metadata jsonb NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT pk_submission_revision PRIMARY KEY (submission_id, version), CONSTRAINT fk_submission_revision_submission FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES data_submission (id), CONSTRAINT fk_submission_revision_actor FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES app_user (id), CONSTRAINT fk_submission_revision_on_behalf_of FOREIGN KEY (on_behalf_of_user_id) REFERENCES app_user (id), CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_kind CHECK (kind IN ('BASELINE', 'CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')), CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_command CHECK (command IN ('MIGRATION', 'GAP_REPAIR', 'UPLOAD', 'LEGACY_UPLOAD', 'HELD_RELEASE', 'ADMIN_DELETE')), -- A baseline comes from a system command, and only a baseline does. CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_baseline CHECK ((kind = 'BASELINE') = (command IN ('MIGRATION', 'GAP_REPAIR'))), -- The versions a kind may take. Across rows, the no-gap trigger checks previous_version is the head. -- Every branch is false, never NULL, when it fails: a CHECK lets NULL pass, so an UPDATE or DELETE -- without a previous version would otherwise be accepted as a submission's first revision. CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_version CHECK ( version >= 0 AND CASE kind WHEN 'CREATE' THEN version = 0 AND previous_version IS NULL WHEN 'UPDATE' THEN previous_version IS NOT NULL AND previous_version = version - 1 WHEN 'DELETE' THEN previous_version IS NOT NULL AND previous_version = version - 1 WHEN 'BASELINE' THEN previous_version IS NULL OR previous_version < version ELSE false END), -- Exactly one actor: a user, or a system code for the system commands only. CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_actor CHECK (num_nonnulls(actor_user_id, actor_system) = 1), CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_system CHECK ((actor_system IS NOT NULL) = (command IN ('MIGRATION', 'GAP_REPAIR')) AND (actor_system IS NULL OR actor_system = 'MIGRATION')), -- A release is an admin acting for the uploader, and names both. CONSTRAINT ck_submission_revision_on_behalf_of CHECK ((on_behalf_of_user_id IS NOT NULL) = (command = 'HELD_RELEASE')) )

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION submission_revision_metadata(s data_submission) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE sql STABLE PARALLEL SAFE BEGIN ATOMIC SELECT jsonb_build_object( 'template_version_uid', s.template_version_uid, 'template_version_no', s.template_version_no, 'assignment_uid', s.assignment_uid, 'activity_uid', s.activity_uid, 'team_uid', s.team_uid, 'team_code', s.team_code, 'org_unit_uid', s.org_unit_uid, 'org_unit_code', s.org_unit_code, 'org_unit_name', s.org_unit_name, 'status', s.status, 'deleted', s.deleted, 'deleted_at', to_char(s.deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), 'last_modified_date', to_char(s.last_modified_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')); END
